label: Starter Review
purpose: General read-only discovery, review, validation, and release handoff agents
recommendation: Install with starter or general software-development bundles.

label: Security Review
recommendation: Install for security-sensitive repositories or release gates.

label: Delivery Review
purpose: Validation, release readiness, and review agents
recommendation: Install for PR, CI/CD, release, and handoff workflows.

label: Architecture Review
purpose: Architecture, repo discovery, code review, and validation agents
recommendation: Install before large design or refactoring work.

label: Testing Review
purpose: Failure reproduction, test strategy, validation, and code review agents
recommendation: Install for bug fixes, risky changes, and quality-focused validation.

label: Backend Review
purpose: API contract, code quality, security, and validation agents
recommendation: Install for backend service, API, or integration-heavy changes.

label: Data Review
purpose: Database migration, validation, and release readiness agents
recommendation: Install for schema, migration, backfill, and data workflow changes.

label: CI Review
purpose: CI pipeline, dependency, validation, and release readiness agents
recommendation: Install for pipeline failures, workflow edits, or dependency-related delivery risk.

label: Frontend Review
purpose: Frontend accessibility, code quality, and validation agents
recommendation: Install for user-facing UI and interaction changes.

label: Documentation Review
purpose: Documentation drift and release handoff review agents
recommendation: Install for documentation-heavy changes and release note checks.

label: All Agents
purpose: Complete subagent set from this repository
recommendation: Install when broad subagent coverage is preferred.
